new_protocols.name: Ibex Market
new_protocols.description: Ibex Market is a perpetual futures DEX on Canton Network offering BTC-PERP, ETH-PERP, and CC-PERP markets with hidden positions, deterministic fills, and zero MEV.

new_protocols.name: InoVaults
new_protocols.description: InoVaults is a code-guessing game on Cronos. Each vault holds a VVS V3 concentrated-liquidity position as its prize; the player who finds the sealed code receives that position.

new_protocols.name: OwlSwap
new_protocols.description: OwlSwap is a non-custodial DEX aggregator with its own concentrated-liquidity AMM, OwlSwap V3 (an unmodified Uniswap V3 fork), on BNB Chain, Optimism, Polygon, Avalanche and Robinhood Chain. Users swap from their own wallets on the same network or between networks; liquidity providers receive the swap fees.

new_protocols.name: Gmoon
new_protocols.description: Gmoon is a Robinhood Chain coin launchpad that creates locked Uniswap v4 pools and converts trading fees into tokenized stocks, ETFs and crypto, which holders earn by depositing coins into the Earn Vault.

new_protocols.name: LPStation
new_protocols.description: A non-custodial, multichain liquidity aggregator for comparing pools and managing LP positions through single-transaction zaps, rebalances and cross-DEX migrations

new_protocols.name: Sweep Finance
new_protocols.description: Sweep is a multi-chain, multi-asset DEX aggregator that moves your crypto portfolio in just a few clicks. Select tokens across chains, choose destination assets, and Sweep handles swaps and bridges.

new_protocols.name: Entry.fi Card
new_protocols.description: Entry.fi offers crypto-funded payment cards for personal and corporate spending.

new_protocols.name: Another Card
new_protocols.description: Another offers virtual and physical Mastercard payment cards that can be topped up with crypto.

new_protocols.name: ATLASX Perps
new_protocols.description: ATLASX Perps is a non-custodial trading interface offering AI-assisted strategy execution and perpetual futures trading through Hyperliquid.

new_protocols.name: XOXNO Aggregator
new_protocols.description: XOXNO Aggregator is a DEX aggregator on Stellar

new_protocols.name: EasyPerp
new_protocols.description: EasyPerp is a non-custodial trading interface offering perpetual futures trading through Hyperliquid.
